title: Global French Connections
description: Explore the diversity of the Francophonie from Quebec to Senegal, France to Vietnam. Experts from the School of Languages, Linguistics and Cultures bring students the French-speaking world through its media (films, graphic novels, songs, podcasts, Twitter). Instruction and media are presented in French, but students have the option to hand in assignments in English.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 265, FRAN 165.
Students are expected to have the ability to understand spoken and written French.
